h1: 5 free printable ADHD task cards, no email needed

faq.q: Are the ADHD task cards really free?
faq.a: Yes. The PDF link on this page is a direct download. There is no checkout, no trial and no catch. The five cards are a sample of the 20-card ADHD Home Reset, which costs $9 if you want the rest later.

faq.q: Do I need to give my email to download the cards?
faq.a: No. The link goes straight to the PDF. If you would rather download from Gumroad, that also works, but nothing here asks you to sign up.

faq.q: Will the cards work if I am not diagnosed with ADHD?
faq.a: Yes. The cards are built for brains that struggle to start boring tasks, hold multi-step jobs in mind, or feel time pass. That includes plenty of people without a diagnosis. Nothing on the cards is medical advice and none of it needs a label to work.

faq.q: What printer and paper do I need?
faq.a: Any home printer on plain A4 or letter paper is fine. The cards print four to a sheet with dashed cut lines. Cardstock lasts longer, and a bit of tape or a magnet keeps each card where its task happens.
